about: Evaluation set for identifying a Pokémon from a free-text appearance description. Each query is phrased the way a user would type it, deliberately NOT copied from data/pokemon_descriptions.json. 'expected' is the dataset slug. Categories: famous (well-known Pokémon), obscure (lesser-known ones), sibling (must be told apart from a similar-looking Pokémon), misremembered (vague, or colors that differ from the dataset 'color' field).
